entities.summary: Janka Maŭr was a Soviet and Belarusian writer, translator and playwright. Janka Maŭr was actually his pseudonym as his true name was Ivan Michajłavič Fiodaraŭ. His son, Fiodar Fiodaraŭ, was a famous Belarusian physicist.
